newsitem.title: UK: Oil prices post modest recovery after recent drop.
newsitem.headline: Oil prices post modest recovery after recent drop.

text.p: World oil prices made up some more ground on Wednesday after touching a six-month low on Tuesday.
Dealers said the limited recovery was hardly surprising given the 15 percent decline in prices since the end of January.
"We've got some short-covering taking it up, but fundamentally the market still looks a little sickly," said a trader in London.

Speculators on the New York futures exchange sharply increased their short positions in crude in the first half of February, according to U.S. regulator the Commodities Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
Attention was focused on weekly American Petroleum Institute (API) stocks data, due for release after markets close on Wednesday.
Dealers expected a further build in crude oil stocks as refiners run refinery maintenance work.

Demand for heating oil, which was a prop for higher prices earlier this year, has dropped off significantly in the last few weeks while supplies were replenished and the weather returned to more moderate conditions.
Private forecaster Weather Services Corp predicted well above normal temperatures in the Northeast U.S., the world's largest heating oil market, at least until Friday.
